summaryZh: Bae 研究组研究软物质的物理、力学和动力学，以实现可编程组装和形变，并探索生物医学器件、软机器人和传感器应用。具体实验方法未明确。

evidence.quote: Search this site Embedded Files Bae Research Group Jinhye Bae Jinhye Bae Associate Professor, Department of Chemical Engineering, Chung-Ang University Office: 310-324 / Phone: +82-2-820-5515 E-mail: jbae at cau.ac.kr Associate Adjunct Professor, Department of Chemical and Nano Engineering, University of California San Diego E-mail: j3bae at ucsd.edu Google Scholar Research Interests Responsive materials, hydrogels, self-assembly, nano/microfabrication of soft materials, printable soft sensors/devices. The Bae lab focuses on understanding and exploiting physics, mechanics, and dynamics of soft matter to develop new pathways of programmable assembly and deformation of soft matter at the nano to macro-scales. The group is interested in integrating material characteristics into new structural design and fabrication approaches for applications in biomedical devices, soft robotics, actuators, and sensors.
